_about: Maps an ASCET block name (the key find_block_type() resolves a weakspot function_name to) -> a TC_xx sheet in the BU new_knowledge_base Excel (TDI-mapped-FCI-Lib-Dynamic_Elements). generate_new_kb_json.py joins this with the per-Case guidelines extracted from each TC sheet to produce utils/new_weakspot_guidelines.json (block-keyed, same shape as the old KB). ONLY STRONG matches are listed; any block NOT here falls back to the old KB automatically (new-only 'replace' policy). LowpassT is intentionally NOT mapped (its only new match, TC_13 'PT1', is weaker than its 8 specific old-KB guidelines).
_tier: Tier-1 = the 5 dataset gap blocks (no old-KB entry) + 2 direct overlap matches. Verified: find_block_type(function_name) resolves each dataset fn to the key below.
